messages:
Noelle Park: Tiny design thread: chart legends are confusing when we show both a 'typical range' micro-tick and full axis. Users think values are averaged.
Gabe Ortiz: Yep — saw a support ticket. Idea: add a small legend pill 'typical range' with an info tooltip: 'Shows 5th–95th percentile to highlight common values; extremes shown on hover.'
Imani Reed: Love that. For the tooltip copy keep it short: 'Typical range (5th195th). Hover for raw points.'
Noelle Park: Also visual treatment: micro-ticks should be lighter but still AA-compliant. contrast-bot flagged current token.
a11y-bot: Recommendation: use a11y token fallback for high-contrast mode and expose aria-labels that read the percentile bounds in words.
Gabe Ortiz: For tiny panels we should hide micro-ticks and show the legend pill instead. Clicking the pill toggles micro-ticks on/off per-panel. Keyboard focus must be supported.
Imani Reed: Implementation note: visual-only presentation; never alter CSV/raw exports. Emit an annotation on the chart when toggled so downstream can detect.
Noelle Park: Acceptance criteria: (1) legend pill with tooltip copy, (2) micro-ticks token update for contrast, (3) pill toggles micro-ticks and is keyboard-focusable, (4) aria labels for percentile ranges, (5) annotation emitted when user toggles. I'll mock the pill and tooltip tomorrow.
Gabe Ortiz: I'll add the token PR and small RFC. ETA EOD.
Imani Reed: I'll draft aria text and keyboard flows.
Noelle Park: Thanks 1:thumbsup:
